info.title: Perfume Shop API
info.description:
API of the perfume shop: a public storefront (catalogue, cart, orders) and an admin back-office.
All amounts are integers in **DZD**. Error messages are in French; business-rule failures answer
**422** with `{ "message": "..." }` (stock problems add `shortages`).

## Testing the admin routes here

The real frontend signs in with a **cookie session**. For testing tools, a local-only shortcut exists:

1. Call **`POST /admin/token`** with `username` and `password` (try it right here).
2. Copy the `token` from the response.
3. Click **Authorize** (or the lock icon) at the top and paste it as the Bearer token.

Everything under `/admin` then works. This endpoint answers 404 outside local development.

## Roles

`owner` can do everything. `staff` can handle orders, use the caisse (POS) and read the catalogue and
stock; every other `/admin` route answers 403 for staff.

post.description:
A perfume may have several sizes, each with its own price: e.g. 10 ml, 20 ml (poured from the
ml stock) and "Flacon complet 100 ml" (a sealed bottle counted separately). In a `standard` type
(cosmetics, watches, glasses...) a product has free-form options ("250 ml", "Rose nude", "Boîtier 42 mm")
counted in units, or sold by ml.
post.summary: Create a product (with `product_type_id` and `variants`) or a pack (`"kind": "pack"`, with `pack`)

delete.summary: Hides the product for good (soft delete). Refused while it belongs to a pack

post.summary:
Upload a photo (jpg, png or webp, 5 MB max). It is resized to 1200 px and stored as WebP.
The first photo becomes the product's main image

put.summary: Set the gallery order; the first id becomes the main image

profile.description: `perfume` = decants by the ml, notes, sealed bottles. `standard` = options counted in pieces (watches, glasses, make-up...).

uses_gender.description: Offer a Homme / Femme / Mixte filter and field (watches, glasses, perfumes).

delete.summary:
Refused while it still holds products: hide it instead (`is_active: false`).

put.description:
`show_unavailable`: show out-of-stock items greyed out (true) or hide them (false).
`low_stock_threshold_ml`: below this many ml a perfume counts as unavailable (default 10).
`low_stock_threshold_qty`: at or below this many units a cosmetic shows as low in stock (default 3).
put.summary: Save settings. Send only the keys to change

post.description:
Returns each line's current price and availability, the lines that no longer exist,
and — once `wilaya_id` and `delivery_mode` are given — the delivery fee and total.
Never trust prices stored in the browser: call this before checkout.

Filters: `q`, `status`, `product_type_id` (Parfums, Montres...), `type_id` (a family or category), `kind` (`perfume` or `standard`).

stock_ml.description: Millilitres in the decant pool (perfumes, and any product sold by volume).

cost_price.description: What the shop paid for one unit (null = not entered); for a pack, the sum of its components. Admin only.

stock_qty.description: Units in stock (`unit` variants only): sealed bottles, nail kits, shades...

wilaya_id.description: Needed together with `delivery_mode` to get the delivery fee.

allowed_actions.description: Workflow actions allowed from the current status.

loyalty.description: Loyalty count of the customer (null when the programme is off or the order has no customer); `adds` = perfumes this order would add once completed.

awaiting_stock.description: The owner put this order aside until stock arrives.

stock_check.description: Pending orders only, when the items are loaded: can the stock cover it, and what is left per line.

change_due.description: Change to give back (caisse, cash only).

list_price.description: Catalogue price when the sale was made (null on old orders); differs from unit_price for a negotiated price.

unit_price.description: Price per unit for this sale, when different from the catalogue price (negotiated price).

discount.description: Amount off the subtotal, in DZD.

amount_received.description: Cash handed over. Required for `especes`; the change to give back is in the response.

product_type.description: The product type (Parfums, Montres...): how the product is shown and sold.

type.description: The family / category inside the product type.

ProductKind.description: What a product is, for stock and display purposes. Perfume and Standard are the two *profiles* a product type can have; Pack is a bundle of other products.
ProductKind.title: ProductKind

product_type.description: The product type (Parfums, Montres...): how the product is shown and sold.

type.description: The family / category inside the product type.

contains.description: Pack contents: "10 ml de Sauvage x1".

SaveProductRequest.description:
Create / update a product (in one of the owner's product types) or a pack.
Stock is NOT editable here (see the stock endpoints).

kind.description: Only `pack` is ever sent: everything else is created from its `product_type_id`.

product_type_id.description: The product type (Parfums, Montres...). Required, except for a pack where it only says where the pack is shown.

slug.description: Auto-generated from the name when omitted.

perfume_type_id.description: The family / category inside the product type (Designer, Lunettes de soleil...).

gender.description: Only kept when the product type uses a gender.

inspired_by.description: Perfumes only. For dupes: "Inspiré de Sauvage – Dior".

variants.description: Products: sizes / options and prices. Send the full list; variants left out are removed (or deactivated if already used).

ml.description: Millilitres: consumed per unit for `pool` variants, bottle size for `unit` variants. Optional for products sold by the piece.

stock_mode.description: `pool` = poured from the product's ml stock, `unit` = an item counted on its own (sealed bottle, watch, shade...).

pack.description: Packs: price and contents. The contents can come from any product type.

SaveProductRequest.title: SaveProductRequest

wilaya_id.description: Required unless the client picks up in the shop.

website.description: Honeypot: must stay empty. Real clients never fill it.

action.description:
`confirm` takes the stock out, `cancel` puts it back if it was taken,
`no_answer` only counts a call attempt, `reopen` brings a cancelled order back to pending.

restock.description: For `return`: put the bottles back in stock?

payment_method.description: Caisse sales only: how it was really paid. Cash needs `amount_received`.

awaiting_stock.description: Put the order aside until stock arrives (it stays pending).

lines.description:
Replaces all items. Variants already in the order keep their original price;
new ones use the current price.

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
